Research Studies

PARC Research Studies

This section provides details of the 4 PARC studies and provide a place for future products. To include:
● Research Studies main – overview of 4 studies and Rapid-Response grants
● Sub-pages for each study (including Rapid-Response grants) – to include description of the study, methods, audiences, communication/dissemination plans, timeline, and all products once completed (manuscripts, research briefs, infographics, toolkits, videos, webinars, blogs, etc).
o To be determined: how much detail of the methods do we post in the short term (during the time before we have products to post)?
o On Rapid-Response grant pages, to include detail on what the grants are, their purpose, how topics were decided, info on how PI’s were invited, and the shortened timeline.
▪ Ensure that somewhere on the Rapid-Response pages that we have linked to Voices for Health Kids (http://voicesforhealthykids.org/); list them as a partner with these grants.
